bounds.actors: Only addresses created for this machine are passed to address-valued rules; arbitrary address ABI fuzzing is excluded.
bounds.integer_values: uint256 ABI; protocol actions bound values to actor balances, MIN_DEBT, collateral cap, BPS cap, and redemption's 1..32 limit.
bounds.merchant_array: Vyper DynArray[address, 128]; current replacement rule uses the three modeled merchants, within the source bound.
bounds.oracle: 18-decimal integer values from 0.3 to 2.0 WAD for ordinary rate changes; deliberate stale/future/zero samples remain deterministic negative cases.
bounds.vault: Asset and share values use integer ERC-4626 conversions; donation and loss actions are bounded to avoid unbounded mock state.
